problem:

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}=-2y\operatorname{tan}⁡(2x),\,y\,(\frac{\pi }{8})=\sqrt{2}.
$$

You are given that $y=A\operatorname{cos}⁡(2x)$ is the solution to this initial value problem. What is the value of the constant $A?$
